meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或脚本变成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要做产品发布或功能宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create a product launch or promo video

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude根据产品链接、脚本或简介，自动规划并生成产品发布或推广视频。它会一步步完成从素材收集、设计、脚本到最终渲染的全流程。
howto.when: 当你提供产品/营销网址、粘贴脚本或简要说明，并希望制作推广视频时触发。也适用于网站导览或展示类请求。

say.text: 帮我为这个SaaS产品做一个发布视频：https://example.com
say.note: Claude会抓取网站内容并开始制作。

say.text: 根据这段脚本生成一个产品演示视频：...（粘贴脚本）
给我的新App做一个宣传视频，这是简介：...
say.note: Claude会从简介开始规划视频。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude automatically plan and generate a product launch or promo video from a product URL, pasted script, or brief. It walks through the full workflow: asset capture, design system, storyboard, script, audio, visual design, frame building, and final render.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a product/marketing URL, pasted script, or brief and want a promo video. Also handles site tour/showcase requests.

say_en.text: Make a launch video for this SaaS product: https://example.com
say_en.note: Claude will crawl the site and start production.

say_en.text: Generate a product demo video from this script: ...
Create a promo video for my new app, here's the brief: ...
say_en.note: Claude starts planning from the brief.
